test_title: SSC CPO 2022 Tier-II Official Paper (Held On: 02 May, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: The passage is mainly about

options.text: the directives from TRAI to the service providers
the close monitoring of network outages by TRAI
the popular service providers- Airtel, Vodafone Idea and Reliance Jio

solution:
The correct answer is** "the directives from TRAI to the service providers".**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The crux of the passage is the instructions issued by India's telecom regulator, TRAI, to telecom service providers in the country. 
 
• It details TRAI's instructions for service providers to improve call quality promptly and implement full-scale, constant quality of service (QoS) monitoring for 5G.
 
• It explains that the directives were issued in a meeting with representatives from prominent telecom companies like Bharti Airtel, Vodafone Idea, and Reliance Jio.
 
• Besides, the passage also delineates TRAI's expectations for minimizing disturbances in existing telecom services during the roll-out of the 5G network.

**Hence, the correct answer is 'Option 2'.**
